primary.label: Start your free skin analysis now
primary.microcopy: Use MyMirror to organise visible skin signals into a clearer starting point.

sections.heading: How to know your skin type—without overthinking it.
sections.markdown: A few calm observations can be more useful than forcing your face into a permanent label.

sections.heading: A simpler check
sections.markdown: A gentle cleanse, a short wait, and area-by-area observation create a low-pressure starting point.

sections.heading: Common patterns
sections.markdown: Oily, dry, balanced, and combination are described as repeated visible patterns; sensitivity can sit alongside any pattern.

sections.heading: Type is a clue
sections.markdown: Weather, routine changes and products can make skin behave differently; a guide cannot diagnose sudden, painful or persistent concerns.

sections.heading: See the pattern more clearly
sections.markdown: Notice the pattern, keep the next step simple, and get extra help when needed.
